lusia-hello.text: Hi. I'm Lusia, and this is my friend Basil. Pick a little house and let's play together.

lusia-help.text: Look carefully. You can do it.

lusia-dots.text: Connect the dots in order. Start with number one.

lusia-realm-studio.text: This is the Little Studio. Here you can paint and create.

lusia-good-night.text: That's enough playing for today. Lusia and Basil are going to sleep. See you tomorrow.

lusia-melody.text: Listen to my tune and play it the same way.

lusia-syllables.text: Put the syllables in order, and then we'll read together.

lusia-coloring.text: Pick a color and touch the picture. Paint it any way you like.

lusia-coloring-done.text: Beautiful. When you are done, touch the green arrow.

lusia-stickers.text: Make your own sticker picture. Drag a sticker onto the meadow.

lusia-letters.text: Draw the letter with your finger. Start at the green dot.

lusia-digits.text: Draw the number with your finger. Start at the green dot.

bazyl-oops-2.text: Hmm, that's not it. Try once more.

bazyl-reward.text: Well done. You get a new sticker.

bazyl-hello.text: Hey. I'm Basil. Come on, it's going to be fun.

bazyl-realms.text: Touch the colorful circles at the top to visit other lands.

bazyl-stories.text: What happened first? Put the pictures in order.

bazyl-history-flower.text: First a seed, then a sprout, and at the end a flower.

bazyl-history-chick.text: First an egg, then the shell cracks, and at the end there's a little chick.

bazyl-history-butterfly.text: First a caterpillar, then a cocoon, and at the end a butterfly.

bazyl-history-snowman.text: First one snowball, then another, and at the end a snowman.

bazyl-history-apple.text: First a whole apple, then a bite, and at the end an apple core.

bazyl-history-ice-cream.text: First a full ice cream, then less and less, and at the end an empty cone.

bazyl-history-froglet.text: First little eggs, then a tadpole, and at the end a frog.

bazyl-history-sandwich.text: First the bread, then the butter, and at the end a yummy sandwich.

bazyl-history-tower.text: First one block, then two, and at the end a tall tower.

bazyl-history-balloon.text: First an empty balloon, then a little air, and at the end a big balloon.

bazyl-history-cake.text: First we mix the batter, then we bake, and at the end there is a cake.

bazyl-history-castle.text: First a bucket of sand, then a sand tower, and at the end a sandcastle.

bazyl-history-egg.text: First an egg, then we crack it into the pan, and at the end a fried egg.

bazyl-history-pizza.text: First a ball of dough, then the sauce, and at the end a yummy pizza.

bazyl-history-cocoa.text: First an empty mug, then milk, and at the end warm cocoa.

bazyl-history-nest.text: First some twigs, then a nest, and at the end a bird in the nest.

bazyl-history-small-tree.text: First a tiny sapling, then a little tree, and at the end an apple tree with apples.

bazyl-history-day.text: First the sun rises in the morning, then it is daytime, and at the end it is night.

bazyl-history-banana.text: First a whole banana, then we peel it, and at the end only the peel is left.

bazyl-history-watermelon.text: First a whole watermelon, then we cut it in half, and at the end yummy slices.

bazyl-history-aquarium.text: First an empty fish bowl, then water, and at the end a little fish.

bazyl-history-gift.text: First a wrapped present, then we open it, and inside there is a teddy bear.

bazyl-history-car-wash.text: First a muddy car, then soap foam, and at the end it is shiny and clean.

bazyl-history-cupcake.text: First batter in a paper cup, then we bake it, and at the end cream and a cherry.

bazyl-realm-workshop.text: Welcome to my workshop. Here we drag and arrange.

bazyl-patterns.text: What comes next? Drag the missing picture.

bazyl-shapes.text: Put each block into its hole.

bazyl-matching.text: What doesn't belong? Touch that picture.

bazyl-jigsaw.text: Finish the picture. Drag the pieces into their places.

bazyl-drag.text: Hold a picture with your finger and drag it to the box.

bazyl-sort-categories.text: Sort them. Each thing goes into its box.

bazyl-sort-colors.text: Put each thing into the bucket of the same color.

bazyl-sort-houses.text: Where do these animals live? Take each one to its home.

bazyl-sort-seasons.text: What do we wear in summer, and what in winter?

bazyl-sort-size.text: Which animals are big, and which are small?

bazyl-sort-motion.text: How do these things move? Sort them.

bazyl-house-ice.text: Where there is ice and snow.
